name: cutline-jury-desk
description: Cutline Jury Desk: a juried design prize desk for a solo founder.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/. dist/public/ && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/server.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --outfile=dist/public/app.js --log-level=warning
